title: Day 1 / 500 — ATS-Y1-001 Initialize the Geospatial Operations Tracking System
subtitle: Year 1 · Java Software Development Intern · Geospatial Operations Tracking System

steps.title: Day 1.1 Verify Java-Experience is empty
steps.why: Confirm the remote starts from a genuine empty project state before any Java source is introduced.

steps.title: Day 1.2 Define Year 1 project and package structure
steps.why: Establish the geospatial-operations-tracker project and com.ats.geospatial package before adding application behavior.

steps.title: Day 1.3 Create GeospatialOperationsApplication
steps.why: Create the first Java source file in the Year 1 project rather than importing a finished application.

steps.title: Day 1.4 Establish the main application entry point
steps.why: Add public static void main(String[] args) so the JVM launcher has the standard entry point.

steps.title: Day 1.5 Add visible startup verification
steps.why: Print the application name and startup status so the first runnable build has an observable acceptance result.

steps.title: Day 1.6 Compile as Java 8-compatible source
steps.why: Compile explicitly with a Java 8 target before later build tools hide the compiler command.

steps.title: Day 1.7 Run the application and verify console output
steps.why: Execute the compiled class and verify the exact startup output from the first application.

data.output: Geospatial Operations Tracking System\nApplication started successfully.

steps.title: Day 1.8 Initialize question coverage tracking
steps.why: Open the repository question-progress file so interview coverage is tied to completed engineering work.

steps.title: Day 1.9 Commit, push, and verify remote state
steps.why: Finish Day 1 only after the implementation is represented by the verified remote handoff commit.
